string.text: Pavel "Waypoint" Voloshin
An Ecologist field guide serving Yantar scientific expeditions. Charts detours, updates maps and leads stalkers to established arrival points.
Waypoint. I guide people out of Yantar. Where are you heading?
I need a guide. Where can you take me?
Choose a destination. The fare covers one journey and is paid before departure. Each route has its own arrival point.
Have you worked here long?

I have escorted scientific field teams for years. They want samples; I want everyone to return alive. I keep route maps, field notes and spare gear here. The Bar has its own guide. Now you can hire me in Yantar.
What does the fare cover?

One journey to the listed point. Choose a route, then confirm payment separately. Without enough money we stay here. An escort does not make local factions friendly. Arrange your return with a guide at the destination.
Here is the fare. Let us go.
I cannot afford it yet. I will return later.
I will stay here for now.
